passage.quote: A project stores descriptions as Markdown with JSON metadata under stratic. A stable identity connects each description to its parent and incoming links, independently of its title or filename. The parent relationship identifies the passage being elaborated; it does not require the prose to be a list of its children.

from.quote: The Markdown file has paired JSON metadata containing a stable id and a parent relation. The parent names another description by identity and selects the meaningful passage that this child elaborates. The project has one root with no parent; every other description belongs beneath a parent, and parent chains must not cycle. Branches may have different depths because some responsibilities need more explanation than others.
